title: Create your account
intro: An administrator invited you with a registration link. Complete these details to create your account.

invalidLink.title: This registration link is not usable
invalidLink.body: The link is invalid or has expired. Ask your administrator for a new registration link.

linkFailed: Your registration link could not be checked.

roleNotice.CANDIDATE: This link creates a candidate account.
roleNotice.SENIOR: This link creates a senior account.

field.numberHint: Leave this empty if the address has no number.

proofHint.MobilePhone: The mobile number registered in your name.
proofHint.Address: Enter the parts of your address separately. They are submitted together as one residency proof.

emailConflict: An account already exists for this email address. Sign in instead, or register with a different address.

invalid.title: Your details could not be submitted
invalid.body: Correct the values below, then submit again.

failed: Your account could not be created.

verification.title: Verify your email address
verification.description: We sent a code to your email address. Enter it here to finish creating your account.

noAccount.title: There is no account to verify here
noAccount.body: Open the verification screen from the link in your email, or register again with your registration link.

verification.resent: A new code is on its way. The previous code no longer works.
verification.resendFailed: A new code could not be sent.

invalid.title: That code could not be submitted

verification.failed: Your email address could not be verified.
